sql_query: SELECT "product_name", SUM("sales") AS "total_sales", SUM("profit") AS "total_profit" FROM dataset GROUP BY "product_name" ORDER BY "total_sales" DESC LIMIT 10;
explanation: This query identifies the top 10 products based on their total sales value. It aggregates both sales and profit for each product name, allowing for a comparison of which items generate the most revenue. The results are sorted in descending order to highlight the highest-performing products.
